trimmingSuggestions.description: Trim the section where Romina repeats her social media handles. This information could be included in the video description or on a title card instead.
Trim the explanation about listening to the sound while recording. It could be assumed that viewers would understand this basic concept, or it could be condensed into a shorter sentence.
Consider condensing the section about mixing the clips. While the explanations are helpful, some parts might feel repetitive for viewers who are familiar with basic video editing.
